atomic_facts.fact: Wirecard AG is a German-incorporated company (jurisdiction DE, legal address Aschheim, DE).
Wirecard AG was dissolved on 3 September 2020.
Wirecard AG had no active business activity as of 2024.
A criminal trial related to Wirecard exists.
As of April 2026, Wirecard AG is subject to a criminal trial in Munich.
Wirecard AG is under criminal indictment for alleged fraud or financial misconduct.
A civil claim sought c. £12m in damages for deceit, alleging a 2016 oral misrepresentation led Wirecard Bank to extend credit to Monarch Airlines.
The deceit claim was brought against Wirecard Bank as defendant.
The case was dismissed in its entirety by Mrs Justice Cockerill DBE, a High Court judge.
The dismissal means no liability was found.
A ban on short selling of Wirecard's stock was imposed.
The short-selling ban was imposed by a financial regulator.
Wirecard AG filed for insolvency on 25 June 2020, owing creditors almost €4 billion.
As of 2026-10-01, Wirecard AG is not undergoing any formal insolvency proceedings.
